findings.title: Controls Over Critical Payroll Adjustments Were Not Sufficient
findings.description: The Center's procedures for verifying the propriety of payroll adjustments were not sufficient. As a result, there was a lack of assurance that critical adjustments, such as payments to former employees for accumulated leave, were proper.
findings.recommendation: We recommend that the Center a. ensure that critical payroll adjustments are verified to supporting documentation, and b. take appropriate action to recover the aforementioned overpayments.

findings.title: A Management Employee Improperly Received Accident Leave
findings.description: We identified a Center management employee who received improper accident leave payments totaling approximately $13,500 over an extended period. The employee continued to receive accident leave after authorized leave was used, and timesheets were approved without the extended use being questioned.

dollar_amounts.context: improper accident leave payments totaling approximately $13,500

findings.recommendation: We recommend that the Center a. monitor the use of accident leave to ensure that only authorized leave is taken, and b. ensure timesheet are thoroughly reviewed and approved by only authorized supervisory personnel.

findings.title: Center Did Not Comply With State Procurement Regulations When Procuring and Awarding Certain Contracts
findings.description: The Center did not always comply with State Procurement Regulations when procuring and awarding contracts. Conditions included artificially splitting procurements to avoid approvals, not awarding a contract to the lowest bidder without proper disclosure, and failing to publish awards on eMaryland Marketplace.
findings.recommendation: We recommend that the Center comply with State Procurement Regulations by a. not artificially splitting procurements to avoid required approvals; b. including the required notice in the IFB for small business reserve procurements, when applicable; c. ensuring that contract award decisions are made in a manner consistent with the IFB requirements; and d. publishing contract awards on eMaryland Marketplace as required.
